mostWorthwhile.text: Using recovered iron in the marrow was most worthwhile because it connected old red cells to the oxygen-carrying protein in new ones.

leastWorthwhile.text: Growing skin cells was clear but fairly predictable: the picture already showed the materials going to the dividing cells.

surprise.text: The recycling cells stayed intact, and the recovered iron travelled in blood attached to proteins rather than as metal fragments.

arbitrary.text: None of the pairings felt arbitrary; the pictures and goals explained why the materials belonged with each tissue.

continue.text: I might continue to see how other body parts renew themselves. The iron-reuse connection was interesting, though the choices here were quite straightforward.
